cases.title: 682 of 685 confirmed relationships never reach runtime because the compiler cannot build a typed prerequisite projection

observed_data.source: docs/audits/hob-587-run-fingerprint.json key_files and the installed profile observation

observed_runtime_result.data_loss_signals: none: no failure carried source_capability_fact_unusable, target_capability_fact_unusable, participant_card_missing or participant_card_unknown, so the 682 are an unsupported-contract (clause vocabulary) gate, not missing data

cases.honesty_notes: Compiler rejection is a representation/implementation gate, not proof of semantic invalidity (issue #587 decision section). The observed histogram contains only clause-binding gates, which is the data-loss/unsupported-contract distinction the audit required. The converse also holds: projection is not semantic certification, as semantic_validity_caveat records.
cases.semantic_validity_caveat: Three projected is not three correct. A typed projection records only that the closed clause grammar can express the pair. One of the three, local-c7a4f08030a1bfb7:relationship:recursion-graveyard-payoff:103442:103442-return-creature-card:103422:103422-0-threshold-graveyard-payoff, is one of the recursion-family rows the #587 review flags for adjudication (rows [10,20] and [30,20] of docs/audits/hob-587-relationship-ledger.json): its source, Gathering of Darkness [103442], returns up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand (frozen Oracle, sources/card-database.json:2543), a graveyard consumer recorded as a threshold enabler for the seven-card graveyard payoff of Most Decrepit Old Bird // Speak Secrets [103422]. Compiler success does not rescue that classification.
